OBJECTIVES
w Measure the input and output waveforms of a common collector amplifier circuit to determine normal operation.
w Observe waveforms in a common collector amplifier circuit.........................
. The experiment in this lesson is not setup to use the selected trainer.
EQUIPMENT REQUIRED
Definition
In this lesson you will measure the normal operating voltages of a common collector amplifier circuit.
INTRODUCTIONM
First, the input and output voltages are measured to determine the class of operation and the voltage gain.
Next, measured values are compared with known values to determine if the circuit is operating normally.
Last, you investigate circuit values on a normally operating circuit.
Let's begin the lesson on COMMON COLLECTOR AMPLIFIER EXPERIMENT.............
